build_mm_kernel: build a TritonTemplate kernel for matrix multiplication with autotuned block sizes and L2-optimized grid mapping
tune_mm: tune the tuned_mm function to select optimal matmul implementation via autotuning for given matrix inputs
tune_int_mm: tune the tuned_int_mm function to select optimal int8 matrix multiplication with autotuned block configurations
tune_addmm: tune the tuned_addmm function to select optimal addmm implementation with bias fusion and autotuning
tune_mixed_mm: tune the tuned_mixed_mm function to select optimal mixed-precision matmul with dtype casting prologue
